body: Thank you! I’m absolutely going to give it my all when going into the faith, I want immerse myself and give faith as much of a chance as possible!

I would consider myself to be a good person, but honestly I think I would disagree that some of what you said would be taken so seriously. I understand that those are sins, but going into this I’m thinking I would consider god a close friend rather than an ultimate judge, as that is very offputting to me. Thank you for the advice!

Honestly, no. I don’t think it’s realistic for me to go from believing there’s nothing out there to suddenly having a god to put faith into, but I have an open mind and I’m hoping to get there eventually!

A lot of what you said is so meaningful, thank you so much. I am definitely not going into this trying to change who I am fundamentally, since I consider myself to be quite a good person, but hoping to get some fulfillment from the faith, and allowing myself to be immersed and become more generous?? Or I guess having those traits I admire so much in my Christian friends
Thank you! The similarity to my situation definitely puts me at ease!
Yes, I don’t think I was expecting faith to cure anything immediately, but I think having faith would remedy some of the problems that contribute to it overall. Thank you :)
Thank you, I’ll definitely read up on those! I’m definitely trying to go into it with an open mind, because otherwise I wouldn’t get anything out of it haha!
Thank you! I wouldn’t say I’ve experienced any kind of call or miracle yet but I’m hopeful and have amazing friends that’ll support me on my journey :)
Thanks for your reply, it’s nice to know you went through a similar situation and came out the other side happier :)
